impact: The module-local suite is excluded from the default run and has rotted. Its 73 TaskRunner test files are the single largest available coverage gain, and none of them run today.
resolution: Superseded. The bulk failure this described is gone: 463 -> 215 across T-012, ISS-010, ISS-011, ISS-012 and ISS-016, and the cause was never product code - the vendored module's tests were written against a different implementation. What remains is catalogued specifically in ISS-014 (five unimplemented task:run flags), ISS-015 (assertion residue), plus ordinary drift; leaving this open would keep implying the original 463.
title: TaskRunner module tests fail in bulk, blocking the largest coverage lever
